note: P4383 (Pro 31:5) — lest they drink and forget the decree and pervert the rights of the afflicted.

dims.v: intoxicated dereliction — drink making a ruler forget the law and pervert the poor's rights

the forgetting of what has been decreed through drink — the intoxicated dereliction by which a ruler loses hold of the law and perverts justice for the afflicted, wine drowning the judgement the weak depend on
the drink-drowned memory that fails the poor who look to the judge

shakach (forget) — 'lest they drink and FORGET what has been decreed and pervert the rights of all the afflicted' (31:5); drink is perilous for rulers, drowning the memory of the law and corrupting justice for the weak. A judge in his cups fails the afflicted (cf 31:4).
